[[File:SenateCrest-TPM.png|thumb|right|250px|The Insignia of Unity (pictured on the [[Chancellor's Podium/Legends|Chancellor's Podium]])]]
The '''Insignia of Unity''' was a representation of the [[Republic crest/Legends|Republic crest]], forged in [[Aurodium/Legends|aurodium]], [[orichalum]], and [[Coruscanthium]], that graced the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] podium.

==History==
The Insignia of Unity was stolen from the podium during renovations by the head of the [[Naffiff Brothers|construction company]] hired to oversee the renovations, [[Sils Naffiff]]. That replica was itself immediately stolen by the [[Republic Group/Legends|Republic Group]] and hidden away. The fact that the Insignia had been stolen was discovered during another renovation after the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]], but not followed up on as the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] had become the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. The Insignia of Unity became a much-sought-after item for collectors; it was only after discovering the first counterfeit, hidden by the Republic Group, that [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Lestra Oxic]] realized Naffiff had stolen the original Insignia.<ref name="Falcon">[[Millennium Falcon (novel)|''Millennium Falcon'']]</ref>
